body.en:

Sources: lastwarvault.com, csmit195.com, Reddit r/LastWarMobileGame

body.en:
Completed buildings and research sit in your inventory/backpack. Points only count when you OPEN/CLAIM them — not when they finish. Keep upgrades wrapped until VS Building or Age of Science + matching AR phase.

Community: Gamoria forum, Last War Vault

body.nl:
De #1 AR-lek: stamina verbranden buiten Drone Boost. Radar missies, rallies en PvP-stamina leveren AR badges alleen optimaal tijdens Drone Boost fase. Bewaar stamina op Ma/Di/Do of gebruik op Radar/Combat VS-dagen binnen Drone slots.

Bron: lootbar.gg, lastwarvault.com
body.en:
The #1 AR leak: burning stamina outside Drone Boost. Radar missions, rallies and PvP stamina only score AR badges optimally during Drone Boost phase. Save stamina Mon/Tue/Thu or use on Radar/Combat VS days within Drone slots.

Source: lootbar.gg, lastwarvault.com

title.fr: Ne montez pas le QG trop vite

Bron: mixcliq.com, community
body.en:
HQ level gates troop tier (T5 only after HQ 30+). Higher HQ = bigger PvP target. Train troops alongside HQ growth. Use Base Expansion VS day for big construction completions.
